review.title: Demo: Handyman Services in Columbus (2D, rebuilt from scratch)
review.text: Rebuilt from scratch as you asked, not patched. New design: warm stone and pine green, Red Hat type, and a clean copy of the design kit (the old build had edited the kit CSS). The root cause of the overlaps is gone: no phone action bar (the stray blue bar), no tall photo beside the form, and every section sized to fit at 1280x720 and 1920x1080. Checked with the layout checker at 1920, 1440, 1280, 1024, 768, 390 and 375, plus full-page screenshots at 1920, 1280, 768 and 375: no text over images, no empty bars. Design gate: OPEN with one finding, a gap under the quote form on phones that my last fix caused. I undid that fix and the checker at 390 is now clean. Also swapped two bad stand-in photos (a soldier in camouflage, a postcard back). Sources and what I took from each: demos/handyman-columbus/INSPIRATION.md. The 3D version is next, in its own folder with its own link.
